messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service=\"inference-api\" severity=critical — rule=latency-p99 > 500ms (current=820ms). SLO burn 36%. pagerduty: PagerDuty: page fired (CRITICAL) — escalation policy=oncall-core.
Sara (oncall): ACKing, oncall here. starting triage.
Mike SRE: +1. quick check — is this global or region-specific? any 5xx spike?
Sara (oncall): Looks global in the metrics UI — p95 ~ 220ms, p99 820ms. No spike in 5xxs, just high tail latency for generate endpoints.
Jordan (infra): Seeing a KV-cache eviction burst around the same time on prod-redis-2. keys_evicted/sec jumped. Could be cold K/V cache causing repeated decode costs.
Ashley - PM: Customer impact? any degraded SLAs or live customers complaining?
Sara (oncall): No customer error reports yet, but chat flows are timing out at client side after 3s in some EU customers. Notified support to watch.
Mike SRE: Let's try fast mitigations: 1) route EU -> fallback pool with higher capacity 2) increase pod replicas for generator service 3) warm KV cache. I'll run the scale and routing change.
Jordan (infra): Command to route EU to fallback:
```bash
./routerctl set-weight --route inference-api --region eu-west --target fallback-pool --weight 1.0
```
Mike SRE: Scaling now:
```bash
kubectl scale deploy/generator --replicas=30 -n prod
```
Sara (oncall): Doing a quick check on autoscaler history — we had a scale-down 7m ago, might've been too aggressive.
incident-bot: action-log: route-change and scale initiated by Mike SRE.
PagerDuty: PagerDuty: incident acknowledged by Sara (oncall). Escalation timer paused.
Mike SRE: After scaling + reroute we're seeing p99 drop to ~480ms at edge, p95 stable. Still some tails at origin.
Jordan (infra): I pushed a KV warming job to populate frequent prefixes:
```python
# warming script (prod)
for prefix in hot_prefixes:
    send_warm_request(prefix, reps=5)
```
Sara (oncall): Confirming user-observed timeouts decreasing. Support reports fewer new complaints.
Ashley - PM: Thanks. Recommend we suppress auto-pager for 20m while we monitor, and open an ops follow-up to adjust scaler hysteresis.
Mike SRE: Agreed. I'll set autopager-snooze 20m and file ENG-OPS ticket for scale policy change and KV caching investigation.
Sara (oncall): handing off to Mike — I have a meeting in 10. Mike, you're primary. I'll be reachable if needed. :white_check_mark:
Mike SRE: Taking over. will run a deeper trace and keep updates here. tagging postmortem owner.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: page resolved (manual). followup: create postmortem if SLO burn > 30%.
Sara (oncall): closing thread for now, will re-open if things regress.
